name: BWYS
recent: BWYS 近期宣布以 RM94.48 million 现金收购雪兰莪 Kuala Langat 一块永久工业地，并调整早前拟议出售资产的所得款项用途。公司同时宣派每股 0.05 sen 的首次中期股息，除息日为 2025 年 12 月 2 日。
notable: 全资子公司 BW Scaffold Industries 以 RM94,479,631.50 现金收购雪兰莪 Kuala Langat 一块永久工业地。
公司拟调整早前拟议出售资产所得款项的用途。
宣派每股 0.05 sen 的首次单层中期股息。

recent_en: BWYS recently announced a RM94.48 million cash acquisition of a freehold industrial land in Kuala Langat, Selangor, and is varying the utilisation of proceeds from its earlier proposed disposal. The company also declared a first interim dividend of 0.05 sen per share, with ex-date on 2 December 2025.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary BW Scaffold Industries is acquiring a freehold industrial land in Kuala Langat, Selangor, for RM94,479,631.50 cash.
The company intends to vary the utilisation of proceeds from its earlier proposed disposal.
Declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.05 sen per share.
